title: $f^!$ preserves integral constructible complexes
statement:
For every separated morphism of finite type $f:X\to Y$, the right adjoint
$f^!$ of [det-prop-int-brown-adjoint] maps $\Dctf(Y,\mathcal O_E)$ into
$\Dctf(X,\mathcal O_E)$. Its restriction is right adjoint to
$Rf_!:\Dctf(X,\mathcal O_E)\to\Dctf(Y,\mathcal O_E)$.

proof.text: The structure maps of X and Y are quasi-compact and separated over Spec k, so Mathlib supplies CompactSpace and QuasiSeparatedSpace. Apply det-def-localizing-closure-ctf-equals-bc to identify Dctf with constant-model Dbc on both schemes.

The constructible preservation clause of det-prop-int-brown-construction gives preservation by the actual compactification image. For every x in X choose affine opens U of X and V of Y with x in U and U contained in f inverse V. Compactness gives a finite subcover. Apply lem-sfb-integral-exceptional-affine-chart to K in Dbc(Y) on each member; clause (1) only of det-thm-int-restriction-glue gives G K in Dbc(X). The chart node retains the affine-space, closed-immersion and local adjoint comparison route.

Translate both preservation assertions back along the Dctf=Dbc equalities. Restrict the given Brown adjunction on Hom sets of the full subcategories. Explicitly lift its homEquiv and inverse using ObjectProperty.homMk; ambient inverse laws and naturality imply the four laws by ObjectProperty.hom_ext. Adjunction.mkOfHomEquiv supplies the adjunction between exactly the functors in ctfRestrictionAssertions.

proof_origin.place: Finite affine cover and glue clause (1), actual Hom-equivalence restriction; chart calculation isolated in lem-sfb-integral-exceptional-affine-chart
